# Accepted functional regression fixtures

These two cases preserve source text, saved normalized NER mentions, saved
relations, and expected graphs from the accepted lineage. SFPQ also preserves
saved role metadata. They are not scientific gold and do not certify quality.

The prediction mappings are reconstructed from saved normalized mention fields;
no fresh NER or provider inference is used. Adapter validation reconstructs IDs
in original numeric order, then replay retains the recorded RE-input order.
Expected outputs are copied from historical files, not generated by the cleaned
implementation. JSON includes original paths and source-artifact hashes solely
for provenance; maintained tests read only local fixtures. Originals remain in
the immutable baseline and research checkout.
